beats.td-5-001: You finally reach the cavernous bottom of the Sunken Stair, standing before the vast, silent brass teeth of the Meridian Gear.
beats.td-5-025: With the outer debris finally cleared, the Last Tidewarden emerges from the damp shadows, demanding your solemn oaths before permitting access to the inner workings.
beats.td-5-051: The Hollow Choir suddenly descends upon the echoing chamber, their drowned voices singing terrible promises as they attempt to drag you into the rising water.
beats.td-5-070: As the dark water rises, desperate representatives from the rival factions burst into the dripping chamber, turning the precarious control room into a deadly standoff.
beats.td-5-086: Orsolya Venn finally appears from the flooding shadows, badly wounded and clutching the master lever, revealing her radical plan to destroy the Meridian Gear entirely.
beats.td-5-106: A truly deafening roar echoes down the dark shaft as the open seabed finally floods, and the ancient Meridian Gear shudders violently to life beneath your hands.
beats.td-5-121: With the black sea violently crashing against the reinforced glass, you grab the vibrating controls to make the ultimate, irrevocable choice of where the water falls.

td-5-002.situation: The immense mechanism is jammed tight with centuries of deep-sea debris and salt crust, requiring immediate physical clearing before any cogs can turn.

td-5-026.situation: The ancient automaton-archivist fiercely guards the alignment levers, forcing you to prove your worth or cleverly trick it to manipulate the returning ocean's path.

td-5-052.situation: The drowned spirits swarm the crumbling control room as the very first trickles of the returning sea begin to breach the rusted pressure seals.

td-5-071.situation: The wealthy Brineholders, fanatic Drift Pilgrims, and your own Wreckers' Guild clash violently over the controls, demanding you choose a side before the sea crashes down.

td-5-087.situation: Your bleeding mentor stands ready to shatter the machine and let the ocean run wild, forcing you to urgently either help her or stop her.

chains.td-5-002/0: You heave a wrecked galleon's mast out of the primary cogs, risking severe exhaustion, to uncover a masterfully forged wrecker's hook trapped beneath.
chains.td-5-002/1: You force a calcified alignment wheel to rotate by sheer strength, risking crushed hands, to gain vital access to the central pressure valve.
chains.td-5-002/2: You smash apart a massive colony of iron-shelled barnacles blocking the drive shaft, risking deep cuts, to harvest a cluster of razor-sharp shell-blades.
chains.td-5-002/3: You drag a petrified leviathan rib from the heavy counterweights, risking a crushing fall, to claim a rare marrow-stone amulet snagged on the bone.
chains.td-5-002/4: You carefully dismantle a broken bathysphere lodged between the great gears, risking sudden structural collapse, to salvage a precious spool of pristine copper wire.
chains.td-5-026/0: You debate obscure ancient maritime laws with the weary Tidewarden, risking its mechanical wrath, to earn a heavy brass access key to the lower shafts.
chains.td-5-026/1: You stare down the towering automaton when it threatens to flood the chamber, risking sudden drowning, to assert your absolute authority and claim a tide-warding lantern.
chains.td-5-026/2: You diligently repair the automaton's damaged memory-coil, risking a painful electrical surge, to receive a flawlessly accurate map of the seabed's shifting salt-flats and sinkholes.
chains.td-5-026/3: You decipher the faded navigational charts scrawled on the wet walls, risking severe mental strain, to pinpoint the exact location of your missing mentor.
chains.td-5-026/4: You quietly slip past the distracted archivist to steal a forbidden ledger, risking immediate lethal detection, to gain powerful blackmail material against the wealthy Brineholders.
chains.td-5-052/0: You walk directly through the shivering ghostly congregation, risking the freezing chill of sudden death, to snatch a coral-encrusted breathing mask from a flooded alcove.
chains.td-5-052/1: You frantically jam the breaching pressure valves with heavy scrap metal, risking a lethal blowout, to buy precious time and secure a watertight leather satchel.
chains.td-5-052/2: You listen closely to the Choir's maddening song for operational clues, risking your own sanity, to learn the ancient spoken command for the main lock.
chains.td-5-052/3: You threaten to completely shatter the central tide clock, risking the Choir's violent frenzy, to force the spirits into yielding a glowing spectral compass.
chains.td-5-071/0: You carefully negotiate a fragile temporary truce between the screaming factions, risking sudden betrayal, to secure a sworn pledge of support from the fanatic Drift Pilgrims.
chains.td-5-071/1: You brutally intimidate the Brineholder mercenaries into slowly backing down, risking a fatal stab in the dark, to confiscate their heavy iron lockboxes of coin.
chains.td-5-071/2: You physically bar the rusted iron doors against incoming rival wrecker crews, risking badly battered limbs, to ensure you maintain total control over the main console.
chains.td-5-087/0: You bravely confront Orsolya about her sudden disappearance, risking her remarkably volatile temper, to learn the devastating truth concerning the ancient Tidewardens' original watery sin.
chains.td-5-087/1: You carefully disarm the volatile explosive charges she planted on the primary drive, risking a premature detonation, to save the mechanism and pocket a rare blast-cap.
chains.td-5-087/2: You help her quietly rig the final sabotage on the release valves, risking being crushed by falling masonry, to earn her deepest trust and a master-work wrench.
chains.td-5-087/3: You desperately wrestle the master lever away from her trembling hands, risking a broken jaw in the struggle, to take absolute physical command of the returning tide.
